title: Multi-Producer Single-Consumer Channels
summary: Send values across thread boundaries using Sender and Receiver pairs.
lecture: Channels transfer ownership of values across threads without shared memory locking.
Calling `mpsc::channel` creates a paired Sender and Receiver. Sender implements Clone so multiple threads can produce messages.
Receiver cannot be cloned. Calling rx.recv blocks until a message arrives or returns an Err when all senders drop.
